description: Search RentCafe.com apartment communities for a US city or one/more RentCafe search URLs, with RentCafe's own server-side bedroom, bathroom, price, rating, pet-policy, amenity, property-type, move-in and sort filters. Returns community prices, amenities, contact and address details.

amenity.description: One apartment amenity that every returned community must offer, using RentCafe's own amenity filter.
amenity.title: Amenity

beds.description: RentCafe's own bedroom filter. `Studio` matches studios; `4+` matches four or more bedrooms.
beds.title: Bedrooms

location.description: A US city as it appears on RentCafe, e.g. `austin-tx`, `Austin, TX`, or `new-york-city-ny`; spaces and commas are converted to the RentCafe URL slug. A full RentCafe city search URL is also accepted. Required in `City search` mode.
location.title: City

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted communities. RentCafe's public city search paginates its own community results, usually 25 per page; the status message reports when the source ceiling is reached.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only include communities with a unit at or below this monthly rent. Uses RentCafe's own price filter, and the record is re-checked after parsing.
maxPrice.title: Maximum rent ($/month)

minPrice.description: Only include communities with a unit at or above this monthly rent. Uses RentCafe's own price filter, and the record is re-checked after parsing.
minPrice.title: Minimum rent ($/month)

minRating.description: Drop communities rated below this. Whole numbers from 3 to 5 are also sent to RentCafe's rating filter; other values are applied to the returned records.
minRating.title: Minimum rating (0-5)

mode.description: `City search` builds a RentCafe search from a city and the filters below. `Search URLs` scrapes one or more existing RentCafe city search URLs and applies any filters you set on top of each URL.
mode.title: Mode

moveInDate.description: Optional move-in date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format; RentCafe returns communities with availability around that date.
moveInDate.title: Move-in date

rentSpecialsOnly.description: Only include communities currently advertising a rent special.
rentSpecialsOnly.title: Rent specials only

searchUrls.description: One or more RentCafe city search URLs, e.g. `https://www.rentcafe.com/apartments-for-rent/austin-tx/pet-friendly/`. Required in `Search URLs` mode. Each URL's own path filter and supported query parameters are honoured; filters below override matching URL parameters.
searchUrls.title: RentCafe search URLs

title: RentCafe City Apartment Search
